My professional profile is organized around two connected pillars: rigorous decision science and production-aware AI systems.

The common thread is trust. Whether the system estimates a treatment effect or routes work through an LLM agent, the important questions are similar: What decision is being supported? What assumptions are required? How do we evaluate quality? What failure modes matter? How do we monitor behavior over time?
